claim: On a current-source eligible pre-camp site, a player can establish a new camp, use the native assignment UI at that camp's actual OMT to assign the same eligible follower, then native-save, quit, reload, and continue ordinary camp work with that follower's CAMP_RESIDENT and assigned-camp state intact.
material_proof: A selected current-source run first identifies the fixture-derived nearby unassigned follower as setup only. It then retains accepted native World/chat, actor-selection, follower dialogue, camp-type, and assignment UI receipts. A post-establishment authoritative observation names the camp identity, owner and actual lookup OMT, and verifies that the same follower character ID has CAMP_RESIDENT plus assigned_camp matching that OMT and usable job priorities. After native save/quit and process replacement, an independent native observation confirms the same follower ID and camp assignment persisted and ordinary camp-work priority controls remain usable without reassigning or restaging the fixture. Each run has accepted cleanup.
material_contradiction: an accepted player action lacks its matching native receipt
the chosen follower is inferred rather than identified, is already assigned, or is direct-mutated after launch
the site or offered camp type is inferred from presentation rather than current native state
the selected menu entry produces no resulting camp identity or a camp at a different site/owner
the assignment UI is not used, the follower ID changes, the follower does not have CAMP_RESIDENT, assigned_camp does not match the camp's actual lookup OMT, or ordinary job priorities are unusable
native save/quit, process replacement, reloaded follower identity, persisted assignment, or ordinary post-reload camp work is missing or contradictory
a selector opening, fixture transform, source inspection, physical key, OCR, screenshot, coordinate, callback, or direct save/NPC/camp mutation is credited as establishment
already_accepted_evidence: R-020 controlled camp setup is manufactured-state setup only.
R-026 Base Missions recovery proves a prepared-camp selector handoff only.
The historical R-009 physical/OCR camp footing is not current establishment proof.
current_uncertainty: Source inspection predicts fixture follower character:25 at OMT [162,36,0], with forest_thick terrain and the anywhere-permitted bare-bones camp recipe; the current native run must independently confirm the actor, offered camp route/type, resulting camp OMT and assignment state. The native dialogue and nested assignment/job-priority menus must be followed from their live advertised owners. Mission, Food, Storage, Locker and Patrol behavior remain independent claims.
forbidden_shortcuts: physical keys, hotkeys, OCR, screenshots, coordinates, or guessed controls
direct NPC, camp, site, or save mutation after fixture install
crediting fixture installation, startup, setup follower presence, selector availability, or semantic acceptance without the resulting camp state
treating establishment as proof of mission, Food, Storage, Locker, or Patrol behavior
honest_stop_conditions: stop before launch if no active source-matched registry selection exists

after launch, preserve the first missing semantic owner, invalid eligibility, missing native receipt, missing resulting camp identity, assignment mismatch, save/reload divergence, or cleanup failure and continue independent clean claims
seal the claim only after the same-actor assignment, persisted continuity, ordinary camp work, and cleanup are cited
